entry_identity: One hierarchy Gaussian property row keyed by immutable global_node_id; the 100000-row skybox prefix is separately persistent and is not a dynamic-cache entry.
hit_definition: A requested hierarchy global_node_id is a resident hit when global_to_slot[id] is non-negative at frame entry.
miss_definition: A requested hierarchy global_node_id is a miss when global_to_slot[id] is negative at frame entry; every miss gathers and transfers one complete 92-byte property row.
insertion: Misses fill free slots first, then selected eviction slots, preserving one slot per missed row; requested output order is restored by ordered slot lookup and GPU gather.
eviction: Deterministic row LRU by last_used_frame; rows hit by the current request are protected; ties are broken by ascending slot index. The reported eviction count is evicted rows, and an eviction event is a frame with a nonzero evicted-row count.
capacity_semantics: Capacity counts dynamic hierarchy rows only. A bounded cache must hold the complete largest current-frame hierarchy request because current hits are protected and every requested row must be simultaneously addressable.
infeasible_capacity: Any capacity below the maximum single-frame hierarchy materialization request raises AlodCacheCapacityError. For the canonical Run009 trace the minimum feasible capacity is 1599906 rows.
initial_state: A fresh process constructs an empty dynamic cache (all global_to_slot and slot_to_global mappings are -1) and separately uploads the full skybox before warm-up.

warmup.sequence_definition: The first ten cameras of the selected trajectory order, once.

transfer_accounting.formal_reported_total: Measured/steady-state dynamic hierarchy full-property H2D rows and bytes only.
excluded_from_formal_reported_total: the one-time persistent skybox upload (100000 rows, 9200000 property bytes)
compact culling metadata uploaded during scene construction
selected semantic ID H2D traffic used by the CUDA filter
retained-index D2H traffic from the CUDA filter
GPU-to-GPU cache copies and selected-row gathers
allocator/runtime transfers not represented as explicit property-row uploads

closure_definitions.warmup: Sum of alod_h2d_rows/bytes over the ten recorded warm-up frames.
closure_definitions.steady_state: Sum over the measured trajectory after warm-up; matches historical formal transfer accounting.
closure_definitions.cold_inclusive: Warm-up plus measured dynamic hierarchy property H2D from an empty dynamic cache. It still excludes separately persistent skybox and metadata/ID traffic and is labelled accordingly.
